name: Words of The Forest
body:
School divination; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, inquisitor 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (piece of bark)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The casters taps into the nature around them, connecting to the fauna allowing them to see flashes of the memories of the forest. By focusing on specific areas or topics, the target can see the past in that area or learn secrets that the forest has learned.

Each round for the duration of the spell, the target can attempt a Perception or Handle Animal check to learn about people or events within or in the forest or view glimpses of other locations within the forest. The check is treated as if using Diplomacy to gather information from local people for 1d4 hours, but instead learns information from the animals and plants of the location. While concentrating on this spell, the user is blind and deaf.
